name: 01_happy_config_entities
description: Happy path: extract all config entities (projects/apps/products/entitlements/offerings/packages) for the seeded project. Asserts all six tables are written with real data.

name: 02_happy_customer_domain
description: Happy path: extract customer domain (customers/active_entitlements/subscriptions/subscription_entitlements/purchases/invoices) for keboola-test-001. Purchases and invoices are empty but present.

name: 03_entity_selection_config_only
description: Entity selection: entities=[config] only — only config tables produced, no customer tables.

name: 04_testConnection_valid
description: Sync action testConnection with valid credentials → success ValidationResult.

name: 05_testConnection_invalid_key
description: Sync action testConnection with invalid API key → failure ValidationResult (authentication_error), NOT an exception. Exit 0 (sync actions always exit 0).

name: 06_listProjects
description: Sync action listProjects → list of SelectElement dropdown options, one per project.

name: 07_bad_auth_run
description: Run with invalid API key → authentication_error → UserException → exit 1.

name: 08_bad_project_id
description: Run with valid key but non-existent project_id → resource_missing → UserException → exit 1.
